meta.name: browser
meta.description: Drives a real browser through the omowright library from the js eval kernel: sites the user is already signed into, forms and clicks, JS-rendered pages, screenshots, web QA, extension popups, a human handoff for login, CAPTCHA or OTP, and a browser you own for scraping, bot-scored targets, network capture and QA traces. Use for any interactive browser task; not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作真实浏览器,完成点击、填表、截图与页面检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要让程序替你在真实网站上点击、填表或采集数据。
copy.tagline_en: Automate a real browser to click, fill forms, and capture screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need a program to click, fill forms, or scrape real websites.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能驱动你自己已登录的真实浏览器：填写表单、点击、截图、做网页测试。遇到登录、验证码或 OTP 时，它会请你手动接管再继续。
howto.when: 当你需要交互式浏览器操作时接管，例如操作你已登录的站点、填写表单或点击页面；普通搜索和未受阻的静态抓取不走这里。

say.text: 打开我登录着的邮箱，念一下最新那封邮件
say.note: 在你自己的浏览器里操作并读取页面

say.text: 帮我填好这个网站的注册表单并提交
say.note: 逐个填入字段并点击提交

say.text: 给这个页面截个图，然后把会话停掉

howto.what_en: Claude drives the user's own signed-in browser via the omowright library: filling forms, clicking, screenshots and web QA. When login, CAPTCHA or OTP blocks it, it hands off to the user.
howto.when_en: Triggers on interactive browser tasks, such as acting on sites you are already signed into, filling forms or clicking through JS-rendered pages. Not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

say_en.text: Open my signed-in inbox and read me the newest email
say_en.note: Works in your own browser and reads the page

say_en.text: Fill in and submit this site's signup form for me
say_en.note: Fills the fields and submits the form

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of this page, then stop the session
say_en.note: Captures a screenshot and ends the session
